info.title: EU TED Public Tenders & B2G Procurement Intelligence Radar
info.description:
Extracts and scores European Union public procurement notices and contract awards from the official EU TED (Tenders Electronic Daily) portal. Enriches CPV codes, contracting authorities, EUR contract values, deadlines, and Bid Opportunity Scores.

### Enterprise B2B Value Proposition (EU TED Public Tenders & B2G Procurement Intelligence Radar)
- **Target B2B Buyers:** European B2G Bid Teams, Multinational IT Integrators, and Global Public Procurement Aggregators.
- **Zero External API Keys Required:** Connects directly to authoritative government, regulatory, and financial primary registries with built-in retry/backoff and deterministic schema normalization.
- **Quantitative Scoring & RAG Briefs:** Every record is enriched with a quantitative 0-100 risk/viability score and an LLM-ready Markdown executive brief (`EU TED Public Procurement Notice Analyzed`).
- **Marketplace Categories:** RapidAPI `Business` | Zyla API Hub `Government & Legal`.
- **Subscription Tiers (USD):** `BASIC` ($0.00/mo, 15 req/mo hard cap), `PRO` ($19.00/mo, 1,000 req/mo + $0.02/extra), `ULTRA` ($49.00/mo, 5,000 req/mo + $0.015/extra), `MEGA` ($149.00/mo, 25,000 req/mo + $0.010/extra).
- **SEO Keywords:** eu-ted-tenders, european-procurement, cpv-codes, public-sector-bids, b2g-europe, official-journal-ojs, government-rfp.

license.name: Commercial B2B API Subscription (RapidAPI & Zyla Hub)

x-code-snippets.Python:
import httpx

url = "https://b2b-quant-rapidapi-gateway.jesleytassili.workers.dev/v1/eu-ted-public-tenders-procurement-radar"
payload = {
    "searchKeyword": "Cloud Cybersecurity",
    "countryIso3": "DEU",
    "maxResults": 5
}
headers = {
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "X-RapidAPI-Host": "eu-ted-public-tenders-procurement-radar.p.rapidapi.com",
    "X-RapidAPI-Key": "<YOUR_RAPIDAPI_OR_ZYLA_KEY>",
}

with httpx.Client(timeout=30.0) as client:
    response = client.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers)
    response.raise_for_status()
    print(response.json())

EuTedPublicTendersProcurementRadarReques.title: EU TED Public Tenders & B2G Procurement Intelligence Radar Request Schema
EuTedPublicTendersProcurementRadarReques.description: Configure procurement keyword, optional 3-letter EU Member State ISO code (e.g., DEU, FRA, ESP, NLD), and maximum EU TED notices to extract and score.

searchKeyword.title: Procurement Keyword / Sector
searchKeyword.description: Public tender topic, CPV keyword, or technology sector (e.g., 'Cloud Cybersecurity', 'Artificial Intelligence', 'Medical Devices', 'Solar Energy').

countryIso3.title: EU Country ISO-3 Code (Optional)
countryIso3.description: Optional 3-letter ISO country code (e.g., 'DEU', 'FRA', 'ESP', 'ITA', 'NLD', 'BEL', or leave empty for all EU/EEA member states).

maxResults.title: Maximum Tenders to Extract
maxResults.description: Maximum number of European public procurement notices to extract and score (1 to 100).

buyerCountryIso3.description: 3-letter ISO code of the contracting authority country.

cpvCode.description: 8-digit EU Common Procurement Vocabulary classification code.

procedureType.description: Open, Restricted, Competitive Dialogue, or Framework Agreement.

publicationDate.description: ISO date when the notice was published on EU TED.

estimatedValueEur.description: Estimated or awarded contract value in Euros (EUR).

bidOpportunityScore.description: Quantitative B2G capture score combining contract value, open procedure openness, and CPV match (0-100).
